notes.title: Epic Megagrant Recipient
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41562367/323178c6f7d2bbbaae0c18c213cad73627ea4d18.png

NUKKLEAR is extremely grateful to be named an Epic MegaGrant recipient as it will help us improve our experiences using Unreal Engine and add exciting new features moving forward. We would like to thank Epic Games for this opportunity.

The Epic Games team has been incredibly supportive and these funds will go directly into making Fog & Silver the best game it can be.

About Epic MegaGrants
Epic MegaGrants is a $100 million program designed to service and assist game developers, enterprise professionals, media and entertainment creators, students, educators, and tool developers doing outstanding work with Unreal Engine or enhancing open-source capabilities for the 3D graphics community.
